title: Delivery
description: Per-recipient delivery lifecycle record for a message. State machine: QUEUED → SYNCING → DELIVERED → ACKNOWLEDGED, plus WAITING_FOR_SYNC (offline deferral — a valid state, never an error) and FAILED (after max attempts, with alert) (PROTO-FR-05, product vision §10). The schema validates snapshot consistency (e.g. FAILED requires error); transition legality is enforced by the sync engine.

messageId.description: The message this delivery record tracks.

recipient.description: The recipient this delivery record applies to (one record per recipient).

state.description: Current delivery state. WAITING_FOR_SYNC means delivery is deferred until connectivity returns — expected behaviour, not a failure.

maxAttempts.description: Maximum attempts before the state becomes FAILED. Configurable.

nextRetryAt.description: Earliest time the next attempt may run (exponential backoff with jitter, capped).

syncingAt.description: When the delivery last entered SYNCING.

waitingForSyncAt.description: When the delivery last entered WAITING_FOR_SYNC.

deliveredAt.description: When the recipient gateway accepted the message.

acknowledgedAt.description: When the recipient acknowledged the message (SYNC-FR-05).

error.description: Failure details. Required when state is FAILED.

createdAt.description: When the delivery record was created.

updatedAt.description: When the delivery record last changed.

allOf.description: QUEUED must record when it was queued.
WAITING_FOR_SYNC must record when the wait began.
DELIVERED must record when it was delivered.
ACKNOWLEDGED must record when it was acknowledged.
FAILED must record when it failed and carry error details.
